about: One row per playable map. track is a polyline in metres relative to center (x east, y north), bloons enter at the first point. spawn is where players start, relative to center.

verify.center: In the running game: the track should sit on open, fairly flat ground near the main airport. The game hides objects within track_clear_m of the track and logs the steepest slope along it ([BTDOPS] track slope).
